body.text: Most people know about Santa Claus. But many people don’t know about Krampus. Krampus is the Christmas demon. He is a scary, hairy beast with two horns. Santa Claus gives children Christmas presents. But, Krampus puts naughty children in a basket. Then, he takes them away! Every December, thousands of people go to Austria. They watch the Krampus Run on December 5. Many people wear Krampus costumes. They wear wooden masks, too. They parade through the streets. They surprise people. Are you scared of Krampus? You don’t need to worry. Krampus is just an old story.
